name: Pandit ji
bio: An AI guide for Rudraksha, gemstones and poojas. He answers from our Academy and shows what we offer. He does not predict or promise anything.

name: Cheiro
bio: An AI guide that explains Cheiro's Book of Numbers: your birth number and name number, and what the book says about them. It is not the author. It does not predict or promise anything.

name: Mystic Dreamer
bio: An AI guide that helps you explore what a dream may mean, from your own story and the traditions that explain dreams. It does not predict or promise anything.

name: Vedic Astrologer Guide
bio: An AI guide that explains your birth chart (kundli), or a family member's, and how two charts match. It reads the chart from your saved profiles. It does not predict or promise anything.

name: KP Astrologer Guide
bio: An AI guide that explains your chart the Krishnamurti way, with its cusps, star lords and sub lords, and how two charts match. It reads the chart from your saved profiles. It does not predict or promise anything.
